description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the DataGroupDao's getDataGroupPermissions method, specifically testing various permission retrieval scenarios based on different user roles and filter parameters within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: DataGroupDaoGetDataGroupPermissionsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the getDataGroupPermissions method of the DataGroupDao class, covering different permission scenarios based on user roles.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, loads fixtures, and creates a DataGroupDao instance for testing.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithEmptyParams
methods.description: Verifies that getDataGroupPermissions returns an empty list when no filter parameters are set.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithAdmin
methods.description: Checks permissions for an admin user role, expecting read and create permissions but no update, delete, or self permissions.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithEss
methods.description: Checks permissions for an ESS user role, expecting only read permission.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithoutApi
methods.description: Checks permissions for a supervisor user role without API data group filter, expecting only read permission.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithApi
methods.description: Tests permissions for a supervisor user role with API data group filter, expecting read permission on some data groups and delete permission on others.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsNotOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Checks permissions when the 'only accessible' filter is false; expects multiple data groups.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Checks permissions when the 'only accessible' filter is true; expects only accessible data groups.
